title: 対策必須！？ミアレシティ

messages.content_raw:
こんにちは　やまだてす。 今回注目したカードはミアレシティ なんとこのカードをスタジアムとして貼るとターンを強制終了させる可能性があります。

みなさん気をつけてください！
messages.content_translated_en: Hello, this is Yamada. The card I focused on this time is Lumiose City (ミアレシティ). Surprisingly, if you play this card as a Stadium, there is a possibility it will forcibly end your turn. Everyone, please be careful!

card_context.effect_en: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends.
card_context.effect_jp: おたがいのプレイヤーは、自分の番ごとに1回、自分の山札から【たね】ポケモンを1枚選び、ベンチに出してよい。そして山札を切る。この効果を使ったなら、自分の番は終わる。
card_context.notes: The official effect ends the turn ONLY if the player chooses to use the search effect. Yamada's post warns that the cabt engine may auto-activate the effect on play, forcibly ending the turn without player choice — a potential engine bug / automation hazard.
